{{SameName|Builder Elf|[[Builder Elf (Cold Ambush)|Cold Ambush]] • '''Krampus Frosthold'''}} {{EventEnded|date = 31st of January 2024|event = [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Builder Elf |image1 = BuilderElfEnemy.png |mode_appearance = [[Krampus' Revenge Event|Krampus' Revenge]] |first_wave_appearance = 18 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]1,200 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Slow (2) |cash = {{Money|1,500}} on death |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Build-A-Soldier}}''' - The '''Builder Elf''' stops moving and spawns 4-6 [[Toy Soldier (Krampus Frosthold)|Toy Soldiers]]. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|If I float up one more time, I'm going to get sick!
Looks like we're in this mysterious force's lair..
Who ever is behind this is going on the naughty list!|[[Santa]] dialogue on Wave 18 ([[Krampus Frosthold]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Builder Elf''' was an enemy that first appeared on Wave 18 in [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It had a somewhat high health and a slightly slow speed. It most often spawned behind groups of [[Papa Bread (Krampus Frosthold)|Papa Breads]], which acted as shields for it. It had one ability, ''Build-A-Soldier'', which made it stop moving and started to make four to six [[Toy Soldier (Krampus Frosthold)|Toy Soldiers]]. ==Appearance== The '''Builder Elf''' was a large pale-skinned humanoid. It wore a green shirt with white fur along the sleeves, as well as stitch lines on the sides of the arms. It had a black and yellow belt, dark green pants, and black shoes. It wore a green Christmas hat, as well as yellow goggles with blue lenses and an apron with black and yellow straps. It wielded a green wooden hammer in its right hand. ==Strategy== *High-damaging towers, like the [[Accelerator]] and [[Minigunner]], can reliably deal with the '''Builder Elf'''. *Splash damage towers like the [[Mortar]] can deal with this enemy's spawns. **In certain cases, the [[Pyromancer]] can be a viable option against the [[Toy Soldier (Krampus Frosthold)|Toy Soldiers]] that spawn. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Christmas 2023 Trailer|'''Builder Elf''' in the game trailer. }} ==Update History== *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Builder Elf''' added. *'''31 January 2024''' - [[v1.12.0]]c **'''Builder Elf''' removed. {{KrampusFrosthold|[[Cookie Guard (Krampus Frosthold)|Cookie Guard]] & [[Gatekeeper (Krampus Frosthold)|Gatekeeper]]|Wave 17|Builder Elf, [[Present3 (Krampus Frosthold)|Present3]] & [[Papa Bread (Krampus Frosthold)|Papa Bread]]|Wave 18|[[Evil Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Evil Elf]], [[Sleigh (Krampus Frosthold)|Sleigh]], [[Toy Soldier (Krampus Frosthold)|Toy Soldier]] & [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]]|Wave 20}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Builder Elf}}
